subject: I was charged ₹450 but the app showed ₹320
description: I took a GrabCar from MG Road to Whitefield. The estimated fare was ₹320 but I was charged ₹450. The route taken was longer than usual. Please investigate and refund the difference.

subject: Missing items in my GrabFood order
description: I ordered 3 items from McDonald's via GrabFood but only received 2. The McChicken burger was missing from my order. Order total was $18.50.

subject: Charged twice for the same GrabCar ride
description: I was charged twice for my GrabCar ride on May 15. Two transactions of SGD 25.60 appeared on my GrabPay wallet. Please refund one.

subject: Driver took a much longer route
description: My driver deliberately took a longer route from Changi Airport to Marina Bay. Google Maps showed 25 min but the trip took 50 min. I believe this was intentional to increase the fare.

subject: Refund approved 5 days ago but not received
description: My refund of SGD 15.30 was approved on May 11 but I still haven't received it in my GrabPay wallet. Reference: REF-44521.

subject: Unfair cancellation fee charged
description: Driver was 15 minutes late and didn't move from pickup point. I cancelled and was charged SGD 5 cancellation fee. This is unfair as the driver was late.
